name: dominatee-building-os
description: 100% Dynamic, User-Configurable, Self-Hosted (Local-First) Smart Office & Building OS

scripts.dev:go2rtc: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not (Test-Path 'C:\ProgramData\dominatee-go2rtc\go2rtc.exe')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'C:\ProgramData\dominatee-go2rtc' -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item 'bin\go2rtc.exe' 'C:\ProgramData\dominatee-go2rtc\go2rtc.exe' -Force }; & 'C:\ProgramData\dominatee-go2rtc\go2rtc.exe' -config server\go2rtc.yaml"
scripts.dev: concurrently --restart-tries -1 --restart-after 2000 "npm.cmd run dev:server" "npm.cmd run dev:client" "npm.cmd run dev:go2rtc"
scripts.build: npm.cmd run build:server && npm.cmd run build:client
